AboutUs.title: About Us
AboutUs.description: Gemoedje.nl is a platform for finding therapists. We offer a wide range of therapies, including psychotherapy, psychology, coaching and much more.

hero-section.description: Breaking down barriers in mental healthcare through cultural understanding and accessibility.

AboutUs.why-we-exist-description: In the Netherlands' diverse society, many individuals struggle to find mental healthcare providers who truly understand their cultural background, speak their language, and appreciate their unique life experiences. Gemoedje.nl was created to bridge this gap, ensuring everyone has access to culturally sensitive mental healthcare that resonates with their personal journey.
AboutUs.who-we-serve-individuals-seeking-care-de: People from diverse cultural backgrounds looking for therapists who understand their unique perspectives and experiences.
AboutUs.international-community-description: Expats, immigrants, and international students seeking mental healthcare in their preferred language.
AboutUs.healtcare-providers-description: Mental health professionals who offer culturally sensitive care and want to reach diverse communities.
AboutUs.support-networks-description: Organizations and communities supporting mental health initiatives for diverse populations.
AboutUs.our-mission-desc: To make mental healthcare accessible to everyone by connecting clients with therapists who truly understand their cultural context and unique experiences.
AboutUs.our-vision-desc: A world where cultural background never stands as a barrier to accessing quality mental healthcare.
AboutUs.accessibility-desc: Making mental healthcare available to everyone, regardless of their background or language preferences.
AboutUs.cultural-sensitivity-desc: Understanding and respecting the diverse cultural backgrounds of our clients and providers.
AboutUs.professional-excellence-desc: Maintaining high standards for all healthcare providers on our platform.
AboutUs.innovation-desc: Continuously improving our platform to better serve the mental health needs of our diverse community.
AboutUs.quality-assurance-desc: Every healthcare provider on our platform is thoroughly vetted, ensuring they meet our high standards for professional qualifications and cultural competency. We regularly review and update our provider network to maintain the highest quality of care.
AboutUs.privacy-security-desc: We adhere to strict GDPR guidelines and implement industry-leading security measures to protect your personal information. All communications between clients and providers are encrypted and confidential.

section-1.title: 1. Introduction
section-1.content-1: Welcome to Gemoedje.nl, an online platform developed and managed by Alonzo Okobia (trading name: Gemoedje.nl, sole proprietorship). Gemoedje.nl aims to help care seekers find a suitable healthcare provider based on personal preferences.
section-1.content-2: By using Gemoedje.nl you agree to these Terms of Service. These terms apply to both healthcare providers and users (care seekers).

section-2.title: 2. Purpose and use of the platform
section-2.content-1: Gemoedje.nl enables care seekers to find suitable healthcare providers through an extensive search engine with filters. Care seekers may only use the platform for personal use. It is not permitted to collect, reuse or commercially exploit data from healthcare providers.
section-2.content-2: Healthcare providers may create and complete a profile to be findable for care seekers. It is not permitted to use data from other healthcare providers or users in any way commercially. Contact and services outside the platform are entirely the responsibility of healthcare provider and care seeker.

section-3.title: 3. Accounts and management
section-3.content-1: Healthcare providers must create an account to be visible on the platform.
section-3.content-2: A healthcare provider can have their account deleted at any time by sending a request to info@gemoedje.nl.
section-3.content-3: In case of forms of misuse, Gemoedje.nl reserves the right to temporarily block or permanently delete accounts. Where possible, contact is first made with the relevant user to resolve the issue.

section-4.title: 4. Responsibility and liability
section-4.content-1: Gemoedje.nl does not actively mediate between healthcare provider and care seeker. The platform only provides an overview of available healthcare providers.
section-4.content-2: Gemoedje.nl is not responsible for the quality of care provided, treatments or communication between healthcare provider and care seeker.

section-5.title: 5. Payments and memberships
section-5.content-1: Gemoedje.nl offers the following memberships for healthcare providers:
section-5.content-2: All paid memberships are automatically renewed. Cancellation must be done via email to info@gemoedje.nl. Refunds are not possible.

section-6.title: 6. Bookings and invoices
section-6.content: Although the platform offers the possibility to book sessions and generate invoices in the future, this is not yet available at this time. At a later stage, healthcare providers will be able to manage bookings and invoices through their dashboard. Gemoedje.nl is not responsible for payment or non-payment of invoices between healthcare provider and care seeker.

section-7.title: 7. Intellectual property
section-7.content: All content on Gemoedje.nl (such as texts, designs, logos and software) is owned by Gemoedje.nl or its partners and may not be copied or used without permission.

section-8.title: 8. Applicable law
section-8.content: These Terms of Service are exclusively governed by Dutch law. In case of disputes, the Dutch legal system applies, with no specific court designated.

section-9.title: 9. Contact
section-9.content: For questions, complaints or requests you can contact us via: info@gemoedje.nl

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.content-1: Gemoedje.nl is an online platform that connects care seekers and healthcare providers. This privacy policy explains how we handle personal data of users and healthcare providers.

section-1.title: 1. Who are we? Gemoedje.nl
section-1.business-type-value: Sole proprietorship, trading under the name Kiab Management
section-1.kvk-registration-value: Gemoedje.nl is not registered as a separate trade name with KvK, but falls under Kiab Management

section-2.title: 2. What data do we collect?
healthcare-providers-list: Profile information: name, gender, location, languages, cultural background, specialties, treatment methods, contact details, etc.
Optional: BIG registration, SKJ registration or other professional registrations
care-seekers-list: We currently do NOT collect personal data from users, except anonymized information via Google Analytics

section-3.title: 3. Why do we collect this data?
section-3.content: We process data for the following purposes:
purposes: Enable healthcare providers to create and manage their profile
Improve the user experience of the platform
Communication and newsletter (only if the healthcare provider does not opt out)

section-4.title: 4. Legal basis for processing
legal-basis: Consent (upon registration or when checking options)
Performance of a contract (e.g., for paid services)

section-6.title: 6. Data retention periods
section-6.content: These parties process data on our behalf, under processor agreements, and comply with European GDPR legislation (or have appropriate safeguards such as standard contractual clauses for data processing outside the EU).
retention-rules: Healthcare provider data is retained as long as the profile is active
Healthcare providers can have their data deleted by sending an email to info@gemoedje.nl

section-7.title: 7. Data security
section-7.content: We have taken appropriate technical and organizational measures:
security-measures: Secure login for healthcare providers and administrators
Only necessary personnel have access to the data

section-8.title: 8. Rights of data subjects
section-8.content: Healthcare providers have the right to:
rights: View, modify or delete their data via their profile
Have their data completely deleted by contacting info@gemoedje.nl
Object to certain forms of processing

section-9.title: 9. International data transfer
section-9.content: Because we use tools such as Google Analytics, Mailchimp and Stripe, data processing may take place outside the EU. We ensure that this happens in accordance with GDPR, including via standard contractual clauses.

section-10.title: 10. Cookies
section-10.content: See our cookie policy for more information about which cookies we use and for what purpose.

section-11.title: 11. Complaints or questions?
section-11.content: Do you have questions or complaints about your privacy or data? Please contact us via info@gemoedje.nl.

introduction.text: Gemoedje.nl uses cookies and similar technologies to analyze and improve website usage. In this statement, we explain which cookies we use, why we do this, and how you can manage them.

what-are-cookies.title: 1. What are cookies?
what-are-cookies.text: Cookies are small text files that are placed on your device (computer, tablet or smartphone) when visiting a website. They ensure that the website works properly, but also allow us to obtain insights for marketing improvements.

functional.title: a. Functional cookies
functional.description: These cookies are necessary for the website to function properly. Without these cookies, the site does not work optimally. We use these cookies for:

analytical.title: b. Analytical cookies
analytical.description: With these cookies, we collect anonymous information about the use of our website to improve it. For this, we use Google Analytics. The IP address is anonymized as far as we know. We are currently investigating whether logging is set up correctly.

marketing.title: c. Marketing cookies
marketing.description: We use the Meta Pixel (Facebook/Instagram) to gain insight into the effectiveness of our advertisements. This allows us to show more relevant advertisements on social media.

cookie-settings.title: 3. Cookie settings and consent
cookie-settings.text: When you first visit our site, you will see a cookie banner where you give consent for the use of cookies. Currently, it is not (yet) possible to select preferences or accept only necessary cookies. This will be improved in a future update.

disable-cookies.title: 4. Disable or remove cookies
disable-cookies.text: You can disable or remove cookies through your internet browser settings. Please note that the website may function less well if you refuse cookies.

questions.title: 5. Questions?
questions.text: Do you have questions about our cookie usage? Please contact us via
